author: opencode-worker-1
text: REFINED MEASUREMENT (worker-1, root-sig feature): with version-auth omitted (qe1t option e partial), the signed DIO packet is ~201B (IPv6 40 + rpl_code 1 + DIO base 27 + config ~10 + 0x17 124). The remaining ~8B overflow comes from the DODAG_CONFIG option (~10B): omitting it from root-signed DIOs would fit (191 <= 194 broadcast budget) but removes the MOP/heartbeat info joining nodes need from the wire. DECISION OPTIONS updated: (a1) omit DODAG_CONFIG from signed DIOs (joiners learn config from a separate periodic mechanism); (a2) emit DODAG_CONFIG only every Nth DIO; (b) SCHC-compress control; (c) fragment; (d) raise the frame cap. The round-trip test root_dio_signature_roundtrip_produces_and_advances is #[ignore]d with this exact cause (tests.rs:2736-2739).
